title: 1991 AMC 8 Problem 13
statement: How many zeros are at the end of the product \[ \begin{aligned} &25 \times 25 \times 25 \times 25 \\ &\quad {}\times 25 \times 25 \times 25 \\ &\quad {}\times 8 \times 8 \times 8? \end{aligned} \]

solutions.text:
Since \(25 = 5^2,\) the seven \(25\)’s give \(5^{14}.\) Since \(8 = 2^3,\) the three \(8\)’s give \(2^9.\)

The number of trailing zeros is \(\min(14, 9) = 9.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: A trailing zero comes from a factor of \(10 = 2 \times 5\)
Count the total factors of \(2\) and of \(5;\) the number of trailing zeros is the smaller count
